name: Spell Hotbar 2 Casts
author: Spell Hotbar 2
description: Per-hand fire-and-forget cast presentation for the Driver Cast states (ADR-0018, ticket 46). The four shtb states stay neutral on the Animations\MSCO_left1-4.hkx path names; these submods select the left-hand, right-hand and dual-hand clip sets by comparing the two SpellHotbar.esp globals OAR can read while the state is live. The left column is owned rather than left to fall through: MSCO's own Self Left submod is conditioned on the equipped left-hand spell's delivery type and would otherwise decide it. Every replacement file therefore keeps the base path's file name and the submod FOLDER is the identity.
